author: blu
body: Minimal JSON value representation, emitter, and parser. Supports null, booleans, integers, strings, arrays, and objects. Objects are lists of key-value pairs (preserves insertion order).

author: blu
body: A caller asking for a number wants the number. Letting JsonNum fall to the catch-all would answer the default for a field that was present and numeric, which is the reading that hides a malformed document.

author: blu
body: All character comparisons go through to-unicode so the parser is correct on the CCE-internal source. The JSON syntax tokens are all ASCII, where CCE and Unicode agree, but using to-unicode keeps the convention consistent with json-escape.

author: blu
body: Both the decimal places and the exponent are bounded by json-max-decimals. Digits past that bound are consumed and dropped rather than overflowing the mantissa; an exponent past it is refused rather than silently truncated, because a wrong magnitude is a worse answer than no answer.
